gaps.explanation: The report itself does not add up, and no printed line is missing. Re-read pp5-13. p10 Exhibit H (Departmental Analysis of General Fund Receipts and Disbursements) prints 17 disbursement lines, all already in detail[] (indexes 12-28): 2,280.00 + 100,977.41 + 7,460.05 + 2,940.49 + 209.37 + 1,707.00 + 27,848.00 + 1,313.23 + 1,922.00 + 603.66 + 16,389.84 + 429.10 + 147.54 + 543.06 + 2,533.60 + 717.59 + 6,788.95 = 174,810.89 (re-added). Exhibit H's printed Total Disbursements is 189,138.55, a 14,327.66 shortfall inside the printed schedule. The printed 189,138.55 agrees with p5 Exhibit D General Fund TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS (General government 188,929.18 + Park 209.37) and with p9 Exhibit G General government operating disbursements Actual 188,929.18. No trimmed page itemizes the 14,327.66, so there is no printed line to add. The Exhibit D 'General government' 188,929.18 is not added either: it is the function total of the Exhibit H lines already in detail, so the same money would be counted twice. The other schedules are complete: p11 Exhibit I Special Revenue (Street 19,985.50 + Keno 3,772.00 + ARPA 42,028.62 = 65,786.12) and p12 Exhibit J Debt Service (25,000 + 6,305 + 54 = 31,359.00). Transfers: p5 Transfers in (out) General (25,548.14) and Special Revenue 25,548.14 are both in detail (indexes 29 and 44). No bond proceeds or other-financing rows are printed in any fund column (p5, p7). The schedule is 271,956.01 and the statement 286,283.67; the difference of 14,327.66 is the report's own unitemized amount (already in report_discrepancies).
